Go,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓgam 1 P, yA-i 2 P, vraj 1 P, cal-car 1 P, pad 4 A, f 1, 3 P; sf 1, 1 P; kram 1 U, 4 P; (as water) vah 1 P, sru 1 P, syaMd 1 A.
Ⓑ

Ⓑ
